title: Beautiful Savior
description: Beautiful Savior in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are anonymous, in print by 1677. The English translation is by Joseph August Seiss (1873). The tune, CRUSADER, is Traditional Silesian. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Beau-ti-ful Sa_-vior, King of Cre-a_-tion Son of_ God and_ Son of Man! Tru-ly I'd love_ Thee, tru-ly I'd serve_ Thee, Light of my soul, my joy, my crown.

lines: Son of God and Son of Man!
Light of my soul, my joy, my crown.
Robed in the flow'rs of blooming spring;
He makes our sorr'wing spirit sing.
Bright the sparkling stars on high;
Than all the angels in the sky.
Son of God and Son of Man!
